tool_schemas.name: tools_documentation
tool_schemas.description: Returns Ennkaheksa documentation for the MCP tool surface: with no parameters it returns a quick-start/quick-reference, and with a specific topic it returns that tool’s docs; depth="essentials" returns a concise guide and depth="full" returns the comprehensive entry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if topic is unknown or depth is not one of the allowed values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if your credentials are missing/invalid and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed request quotas.

topic.description: Tool name (e.g., "search_nodes") or "overview" for general guide. Leave empty for quick reference.

depth.description: Level of detail. "essentials" (default) for quick reference, "full" for comprehensive docs.

tool_schemas.name: list_nodes
tool_schemas.description: Lists registered n8n node types, optionally filtered by exact package name, single category, developmentStyle, and/or isAITool, returning up to limit results (default 50, max 500). This endpoint is not paged; if more than limit nodes match, you must re-run with a higher limit (up to the maximum) or narrow filters. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values (including non-exact package names), UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

package.description: EXACT package name: "n8n-nodes-base" (435 core integrations like Slack, Gmail) or "@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain" (90 AI nodes). No other values work.

category.description: Single category only: "trigger" | "transform" | "output" | "input" | "AI". Returns all nodes in that category.

developmentStyle.description: Implementation type. Most nodes are "programmatic". Rarely needed.

isAITool.description: true = only nodes with usableAsTool for AI agents (263 nodes). Use list_ai_tools instead for better results.

limit.description: Results limit. Default 50 may miss nodes - use 200+ for complete results. Max 500.

tool_schemas.name: get_node_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the complete normalized technical schema for the requested nodeType (including properties/operations/credentials metadata) as a single large payload. Raises NOT_FOUND if nodeType does not exist in the registry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if nodeType is missing or not in a supported prefix format, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

nodeType.description: FULL node type with prefix. Format: "nodes-base.{name}" or "nodes-langchain.{name}". Common examples: "nodes-base.httpRequest", "nodes-base.webhook", "nodes-base.code", "nodes-base.slack", "nodes-base.gmail", "nodes-base.googleSheets", "nodes-base.postgres", "nodes-langchain.openAi", "nodes-langchain.agent". CASE SENSITIVE!

tool_schemas.name: search_nodes
tool_schemas.description: Searches the node registry for node types matching the provided query across names and available textual metadata, returning up to limit matches (default 20). Results are not paged; increase limit (within allowed bounds) to retrieve more matches. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty/invalid or limit is out of range, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

query.description: Search term - MUST BE SINGLE WORD for best results! Good: "slack", "email", "http", "sheet", "database", "webhook". Bad: "send slack message", "read spreadsheet". Case-insensitive.

limit.description: Max results. Default 20 is usually enough. Increase if needed.

tool_schemas.name: list_ai_tools
tool_schemas.description: Lists node types flagged as usableAsTool=true, optionally restricted by package, category, and/or developmentStyle, returning up to limit results (default 50, max 500). This endpoint is not paged; if matches exceed limit you must increase limit or add filters. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

package.description: EXACT package name to restrict results (e.g., "n8n-nodes-base" or "@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain").

category.description: Restrict to a single node category.

developmentStyle.description: Restrict to nodes by implementation style.

limit.description: Max results to return. Default 50. Max 500.

tool_schemas.name: get_node_documentation
tool_schemas.description: Returns human-readable node documentation (markdown) for the given nodeType when available, or a documented “No documentation available” response when the node has no curated docs. Raises NOT_FOUND if nodeType is not present in the registry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if nodeType is missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

nodeType.description: Full node type WITH prefix (same as get_node_info): "nodes-base.slack", "nodes-base.httpRequest", etc. CASE SENSITIVE!

tool_schemas.name: get_database_statistics
tool_schemas.description: Returns a snapshot summary of the registry (counts by package/category, AI-tool coverage, documentation coverage, and related ecosystem totals). Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded. This endpoint does not take parameters and raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any are provided.

tool_schemas.name: get_node_essentials
tool_schemas.description: Returns a compact, task-oriented subset of the node schema for nodeType (the key required/common properties and representative examples) intended for most configuration use cases. Raises NOT_FOUND if nodeType does not exist in the registry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if nodeType is missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

nodeType.description: Full node type WITH prefix: "nodes-base.httpRequest", "nodes-base.webhook", etc. Same format as get_node_info.

tool_schemas.name: search_node_properties
tool_schemas.description: Searches within a single nodeType’s schema/documentation metadata for properties matching query and returns up to maxResults hits with their paths and descriptions (default 20). Results are not paged; reduce the query scope or raise maxResults within allowed bounds to see more. Raises NOT_FOUND if nodeType is unknown, VALIDATION_ERROR if required inputs are missing/invalid or maxResults is out of range, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

nodeType.description: Full node type WITH prefix (same as get_node_info).

query.description: Property name or keyword to search for. Examples: "auth", "header", "body", "json", "timeout".

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 20.

tool_schemas.name: get_node_for_task
tool_schemas.description: Returns a pre-configured node setup blueprint for the requested task, including defaults and explicit placeholders for user-supplied values. Raises NOT_FOUND if task is not one of the supported task templates. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if task is missing/empty, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

task.description: The task to accomplish. Available tasks: get_api_data, post_json_request, call_api_with_auth, receive_webhook, webhook_with_response, query_postgres, insert_postgres_data, chat_with_ai, ai_agent_workflow, transform_data, filter_data, send_slack_message, send_email. Use list_tasks to see all available tasks.

tool_schemas.name: list_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists the available task templates, optionally filtered by category, and returns the task names grouped by category (this endpoint does not paginate). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `category` is provided but is not one of the supported categories, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the catalog. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

category.description: Optional category filter: HTTP/API, Webhooks, Database, AI/LangChain, Data Processing, Communication

tool_schemas.name: validate_node_operation
tool_schemas.description: Verify your node configuration is correct before using it. Checks: required fields are present, values are valid types/formats, operation-specific rules are met. Returns specific errors with fixes (e.g., "Channel required to send Slack message - add channel: '#general'"), warnings about common issues, working examples when errors found, and suggested next steps. Smart validation that only checks properties relevant to your selected operation/action. Essential for Slack, Google Sheets, MongoDB, OpenAI nodes. Supports validation profiles for different use cases.

config.description: Your node configuration. Must include operation fields (resource/operation/action) if the node has multiple operations.

profile.description: Validation profile: minimal (only required fields), runtime (critical errors only), ai-friendly (balanced - default), strict (all checks including best practices)

tool_schemas.name: validate_node_minimal
tool_schemas.description: Validates a node configuration for a given `nodeType` by checking only for missing required fields and returns the list of required field paths that are absent (no warnings, suggestions, or examples). Raises NOT_FOUND if `nodeType` is not present in the registry, and VALIDATION_ERROR if `config` is not an object or required inputs are missing/ill-typed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if access is denied and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_property_dependencies
tool_schemas.description: Returns the dependency graph that drives property visibility for the given `nodeType`, and if `config` is provided, also returns which properties would be visible/hidden under those settings. Raises NOT_FOUND if `nodeType` is unknown, and VALIDATION_ERROR if `config` is provided but is not an object. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if access is denied and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

config.description: Optional partial configuration to check visibility impact

tool_schemas.name: get_node_as_tool_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns AI-tool metadata for the given `nodeType`, including whether it can be used as a tool, common use cases, requirements, and examples (even for nodes not explicitly marked as AI tools). Raises NOT_FOUND if `nodeType` is not in the registry, and VALIDATION_ERROR if `nodeType` is missing or not a string. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if access is denied and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

nodeType.description: Full node type WITH prefix: "nodes-base.slack", "nodes-base.googleSheets", etc.

tool_schemas.name: list_node_templates
tool_schemas.description: Lists workflow templates that reference any of the provided `nodeTypes` and returns up to `limit` matches (no cursor-based paging; increase `limit` to retrieve more). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `nodeTypes` is empty, contains non-strings, or `limit` is not a positive number, and NOT_FOUND if none of the provided node types exist in the registry. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if access is denied and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

nodeTypes.description: Array of node types to search for (e.g., ["n8n-nodes-base.httpRequest", "n8n-nodes-base.openAi"])

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return. Default 10.

tool_schemas.name: get_template
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single workflow template by `templateId` and returns the complete workflow JSON ready to import into n8n. Raises NOT_FOUND if no template exists for `templateId`, and VALIDATION_ERROR if `templateId` is missing or not a number. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if access is denied and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_template(templateId, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0396000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0396000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"

    def _log(status, params, response_summary=None, error_code=None):
        api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")
        rid = _new_id("req")
        duration_ms = int(max(0, (time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        row = {
            "id": rid,
            "tool_name": "get_template",
            "request_params": params if isinstance(params, dict) else {},
            "response_summary": response_summary,
            "status": status,
            "error_code": error_code,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        api_requests.append(row)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)

    params = {"templateId": templateId}

    # Validation
    if templateId is None or not isinstance(templateId, (int, float)) or isinstance(templateId, bool):
        _log("error", params, {"status": "error"}, "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "`templateId` is required and must be a number.", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR")

    # Lookup
    templates = _load("workflow_templates.json")
    match = None
    for t in templates:
        if t.get("external_template_id") == templateId:
            match = t
            break

    if not match or match.get("status") == "removed":
        _log("error", params, {"status": "error"}, "TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND")
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Template not found.", error_code="TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND")

    body = {
        "templateId": match.get("external_template_id"),
        "id": match.get("id"),
        "name": match.get("name"),
        "description": match.get("description"),
        "viewCount": match.get("view_count"),
        "publishedAt": match.get("published_at"),
        "sourceUrl": match.get("source_url"),
        "taskTag": match.get("task_tag"),
        "workflow": match.get("workflow_json"),
        "lastSyncedAt": match.get("last_synced_at"),
        "status": match.get("status"),
        "updatedAt": match.get("updated_at"),
    }

    _log("ok", params, {"templateId": match.get("external_template_id")}, None)
    return body

tool_schemas.name: search_templates
tool_schemas.description: Searches workflow templates by keyword matches in template names and descriptions only, returning up to `limit` results (no paging; increase `limit` to retrieve more). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is empty/not a string or `limit` is not a positive number. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if access is denied and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Search query for template names/descriptions. NOT for node types! Examples: "chatbot", "automation", "social media", "webhook". For node-based search use list_node_templates instead.

tool_schemas.name: get_templates_for_task
tool_schemas.description: Returns a curated list of recommended workflow templates for the specified `task` use case. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task` is not one of the supported enum values, and NOT_FOUND if the task is valid but no curated templates are currently available for it. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if access is denied and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

task.description: The type of task to get templates for

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_templates_for_task(task, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0396000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0396000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"

    def _log(status, params, response_summary=None, error_code=None):
        api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")
        rid = _new_id("req")
        duration_ms = int(max(0, (time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        row = {
            "id": rid,
            "tool_name": "get_templates_for_task",
            "request_params": params if isinstance(params, dict) else {},
            "response_summary": response_summary,
            "status": status,
            "error_code": error_code,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        api_requests.append(row)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)

    params = {"task": task}

    allowed = {
        "ai_automation",
        "data_sync",
        "webhook_processing",
        "email_automation",
        "slack_integration",
        "data_transformation",
        "file_processing",
        "scheduling",
        "api_integration",
        "database_operations",
    }
    if not isinstance(task, str) or task not in allowed:
        _log("error", params, {"status": "error"}, "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err(
            "VALIDATION_ERROR",
            "`task` must be one of the supported enum values.",
            allowed=list(sorted(allowed)),
            error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
        )

    templates = _load("workflow_templates.json")
    matches = [t for t in templates if t.get("status") == "active" and t.get("task_tag") == task]

    matches.sort(
        key=lambda t: (
            int(t.get("view_count") or 0),
            (t.get("updated_at") or t.get("published_at") or ""),
        ),
        reverse=True,
    )

    if not matches:
        _log("error", params, {"count": 0}, "TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND")
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "No curated templates available for this task.", error_code="TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND")

    results = [{
        "templateId": t.get("external_template_id"),
        "name": t.get("name"),
        "description": t.get("description"),
        "viewCount": t.get("view_count"),
        "publishedAt": t.get("published_at"),
        "sourceUrl": t.get("source_url"),
        "taskTag": t.get("task_tag"),
        "updatedAt": t.get("updated_at"),
    } for t in matches]

    resp = {
        "task": task,
        "results": results,
        "count": len(results),
    }
    _log("ok", params, {"count": len(results)}, None)
    return resp

tool_schemas.name: validate_workflow
tool_schemas.description: Validate an entire n8n workflow before deployment. Checks: workflow structure, node connections (including ai_tool connections), expressions, best practices, AI Agent configurations, and more. Returns comprehensive validation report with errors, warnings, and suggestions. Essential for AI agents building complete workflows. Validates AI tool connections and $fromAI() expressions. Prevents common workflow errors before they happen.

workflow.description: The complete workflow JSON to validate. Must include nodes array and connections object.

validateNodes.description: Validate individual node configurations. Default true.

validateConnections.description: Validate node connections and flow. Default true.

validateExpressions.description: Validate n8n expressions syntax and references. Default true.

profile.description: Validation profile for node validation. Default "runtime".

tool_schemas.name: validate_workflow_connections
tool_schemas.description: Validates only workflow connectivity and graph rules for the provided `workflow`, including references to existing nodes, cycle detection, orphaned nodes, trigger node setup, and validity of AI agent/tool connection types, and returns a connection-validation report. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `workflow` is missing required structure (e.g., missing/ill-typed `nodes` or `connections`) or contains invalid node/connection shapes, and CONFLICT when the graph violates hard constraints (e.g., cycles, invalid trigger topology, or incompatible AI tool wiring). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if access is denied and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workflow.description: The workflow JSON with nodes array and connections object.

tool_schemas.name: validate_workflow_expressions
tool_schemas.description: Validate all n8n expressions in a workflow. Checks: expression syntax ({{ }}), variable references ($json, $node, $input), node references exist, context availability. Returns specific errors with locations. Use this to catch expression errors before runtime.

workflow.description: The workflow JSON to check for expression errors.

tool_schemas.name: list_node_packages
tool_schemas.description: Lists registered n8n node packages (publishers), optionally filtered by status and/or packageName prefix, returning a paginated result set. Returns package metadata and cached counts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination values, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

status.description: Restrict results to a single package lifecycle status.

packageNamePrefix.description: Case-insensitive prefix filter for node_packages.package_name (e.g., "n8n-" or "@n8n/").

limit.description: Max results to return per page. Must be between 1 and 200.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Omit to start at the beginning.

tool_schemas.name: get_node_package
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single node package by id. Returns the normalized package record including status, counts, and sync timestamps. Raises NOT_FOUND if the package id does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: update_node_package_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a node package lifecycle status. Only declared transitions are allowed (active→deprecated/disabled, deprecated→disabled). Returns the updated package record. Refuses invalid transitions with VALIDATION_ERROR and non-existent ids with NOT_FOUND. Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

status.description: New lifecycle status to set (must be a valid transition from the current status).

tool_schemas.name: get_workflow_template_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single workflow template by internal id (workflow_templates.id). Returns the full template including workflow_json when available. Raises TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND if the template does not exist or has status=removed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

includeWorkflowJson.description: When true (default), includes workflow_json; when false, omits it for faster responses.

tool_schemas.name: list_task_templates
tool_schemas.description: Lists task templates (task_templates) used to tag and recommend workflows, optionally filtered by status and/or category. Returns a paginated result set. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination values, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

status.description: Restrict results to a single task template lifecycle status.

category.description: Restrict results to a single task_templates.category value (exact match).

limit.description: Max results to return per page. Must be between 1 and 200.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Omit to start at the beginning.

metadata.name: ennkaheksa
metadata.description: Ennkaheksa is a read-heavy catalog and validation backend for the n8n ecosystem. It stores a normalized registry of n8n node types (with schemas, docs, and AI-tool metadata), a workflow-template index (including template JSON and node-type usage), and an audit log of validation/documentation request
